   - **Ongoing Evaluation and Feedback Mechanisms:** Implement systems to monitor the adoption process and gather feedback, allowing for continuous improvement of the shared library and associated support services.

   By addressing these areas, the policy can more effectively mitigate the barriers and risks associated with AI adoption, fostering a more inclusive and sustainable AI ecosystem in Canada.
